text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Everything that is about to happen is not a dream.
So, let's keep our eyes wide open.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's make intense, unforgettable memories for me... and for everyone!
Let's make every single moment—shine.

"...Her words trailed off there.
But—that was enough.
That was more than enough to convey her feelings."

That day it was decided she would run in the Twinkle Series.
With sparkling eyes, she was bursting with excitement
for the future...

As she heads toward the greatest conclusion right now—
Fine Motion is more beautiful
than in any of my memories.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa... It really is Fine Motion! I thought she'd aim for something like the Arima Kinen, but...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of race it'll turn out to be?
My heart's starting to pound a little...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on~!?
Fine-san isn't the only star here, you know!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Fine-san!
Is it true that the day you return home is drawing near?!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"In that case! Today, no questions asked!
I shall mercilessly beat you to a pulp~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because facing a "rival" with everything you have...
is proper princess etiquette!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hit me with everything you've got.
However—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'll just bounce it right back,
and take the win, okay?♪
